source: NGX audited annual report (filed PDF, _ngx_pdf) FY2025 | CRON 2026-10-07 NGX Q2 2026 filing fill: Condensed interim statement of profit or loss, Group 30 June 2026 column, NGN thousands. Insurance revenue 96,487,467; Insurance service expenses 61,132,888 plus net expense from reinsurance contracts held 22,149,017 gives the cost of sales line 83,281,905 and the printed Insurance service results 13,205,562; expenses for marketing and administration 1,476,723 plus employee benefit 5,182,271 plus other operating 5,694,937 gives operating expenses 12,353,931; Profit before tax 8,407,312; Income tax 640,383; Profit for the period 7,766,929. Ties: 96,487,467 less 83,281,905 equals 13,205,562, and 8,407,312 less 640,383 equals 7,766,929. CORRECTION 2026-10-07: the stored H1 2026 column held the period profit 7,766,929 in both the Gross Profit and the Profit Before Tax rows.
